# Where each agency publishes its own GIS / open-data contact

Copied from the club agency atlas (`tips/agency-atlas/<area>.md`, section "Open-data portal"). The engine has **no agency
contacts** and lists **no people**. If a layer is wrong or gone, a person opens the portal below and uses the contact link the
agency itself publishes there (if it publishes one). **Bots never send email.** Links were written by the club; the engine did not
guess any. Areas with no portal in the atlas are left out.

| Area | Portal(s) from the atlas |
|---|---|
| W-AT | https://www.data.gv.at/ <br> https://www.umweltbundesamt.at/umweltthemen/naturschutz/schutzgebiete |
| W-AU | https://www.dcceew.gov.au/environment/land/nrs/science/capad <br> https://datasets.seed.nsw.gov.au/ |
| W-CH | https://data.geo.admin.ch/ <br> https://map.geo.admin.ch/ |
| W-DE | https://geodienste.bfn.de/schutzgebiete <br> https://www.bfn.de/daten-und-fakten/schutzgebiete |
| W-ES | https://www.miteco.gob.es/es/biodiversidad/servicios/banco-datos-naturaleza/informacion-disponible/enp_descargas.html <br> https://wms.mapama.gob.es/sig/Biodiversidad/ENP/wms.aspx |
| W-FR | https://inpn.mnhn.fr/telechargement/cartes-et-information-geographique/ep <br> https://www.data.gouv.fr/ |
| W-GB | https://naturalengland-defra.opendata.arcgis.com/ <br> https://opendata.nature.scot/ |
| W-IT | https://gn.mase.gov.it/portale/servizio-wfs <br> https://www.mase.gov.it/pagina/elenco-ufficiale-delle-aree-protette-euap |
| W-JP | https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-A10-v3_1.html <br> https://www.biodic.go.jp/ |
| W-NL | https://www.pdok.nl/datasets <br> https://service.pdok.nl/ |
| W-NO | https://kart.naturbase.no/ <br> https://kartkatalog.geonorge.no/ |
| W-PL | https://geoserwis.gdos.gov.pl/mapy/ <br> https://sdi.gdos.gov.pl/wfs |
| W-PT | https://geocatalogo.icnf.pt/ <br> https://snig.dgterritorio.gov.pt/ |
| W-RO | http://ananp.gov.ro/ <br> https://geoportal.gov.ro/ |
| W-SE | https://skyddadnatur.naturvardsverket.se/ <br> https://geodata.naturvardsverket.se/ |
